surgical ovarian ablation, performed by laparoscopic BSo, is more cost-effective in the adjuvante treatment of hormone-sensitive early breast cancer than ovarian suppression by GnRH analogues.
laparoscopic BOS is more cost-effective in the adjuvante setting of premenopausal breast cancer patients aged between 40 and 49.
laparoscopic BOS is more cost-effective in terms of QoL, costs and effectiveness compared to GnRH analogue in the adjuvants treatment of breast cancer patients aged between 40 and 49 years.
